{{For|the enemies|Fiends}}

{{Nihongo|'''The Demon'''|邪神|Jashin|lit "Evil God"}} is the main worldly threat and final boss of ''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'' and ''[[Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos]]''.

==Appearance==
The Dark God has a large insectoid body with a grotesquely misshapen humanoid head. On its abdomen is a crystal orb, which was used on [[Jô Hayabusa]] to control him as the Masked Devil. Even with its head cut off, it could still fight by using energy assaults.

== Story ==
=== ''Ninja Gaiden'' ===
In the distant past, the Demon came to Earth and caused many death, but then a [[Dragon Ninja]] of the [[Hayabusa Ninja Clan|Hayabusa Clan]] borrowed the strength of the [[Dragon Sword]] to overcome it. Though defeated, the Demon was not dead; so the ninja confined its evil power in the statue of "light" and of "shadow", and the body itself was imprisoned in the Temple of Darkness, where no gods are worshipped. 

In the 20th century, american archeologist Dr. [[Walter Smith]] rediscovered this 2000 years old temple during an expedition to old Amazon ruins with his partner [[Jô Hayabusa]], leader of the Hayabusa Ninja Clan. They found the two demon statues, alongside a stone tablet. Beyond recording its mythos, the tablet also recited the rebirth of the Demon once every 700 years when the two statues are reunited under a lunar esclipse. To stop anyone from bringing it back to life, it was decided that Jô would keep the "shadow" statue, and Dr. Smith would keep the "light" statue. Walter Smith then proceeded to seal off the ruins.

Later, however, a man named [[Jaquio|Guardia de mieux]], who called himself the Jaquio, took over the ruins; he planned to awake the King of Darkness to gain incredible power to control the entire world. To this end, the Jaquio sent the evil forces of "[[The Malice Four]]" to hunt down the demon statues. With the death of both Jô Hayabusa and Walter Smith, the yound Dragon Ninja [[Ryu Hayabusa]] stepped in to take revenge for his father with the help of CIA agent [[Irene Lew]].    

Despite Ryu felling the Jaquio in battle, he failed to take the statues out of the temple before the moon grew dark, and the Demon was brough back to life. However, the King of Darkness was ultimately defeated, and the temple crumbled upon itself with a deafening roar. Ryu and Irene looked out upon the ruins of the temple. The morning sun shone down upon them and cleared up the deep sense of darkness and evil that had once hovered in the air.

===''Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos''===
It is revealed that the [[Dark Sword of Chaos]] was forged using a piece of the demon's body centuries ago. After the defeat of the demon at the hands of Ryu Hayabusa's hands, the Demon's spirit possessed the dead body of the Jaquio. Jaquio planned to throw open the Gates of Darkness and usher in the Age of Eternal Darkness. After the Jaquio is defeated a second time, his blood awakens the Sword of Chaos and transforms him into a monstrous creature. Ryu defeats the transformed Jaquio, only to face the fully reincarnated Demon itself. Through the power of the Dragon Sword, the Dark God is vanquished, resealing the gates of Hell.

===''Ninja Ryukenden'' (OVA)===
After the Demon was destroyed, two professors, Bucky Wise and Ned Friedman, collected a fragment of the Demon's body and recorded the surge of the Demon's power. To make a copy based on this Bucky Wise kidnapped Friedman's daughter Katherine Friedman, and persuaded him to aid him, resulting in the creation of a superhuman manufacturing device. Once Ned baited Ryu into searching for [[Irene Lew]], Bucky Wise reveals his true colors, explaining that the form Dark God's power was inside of him. Ryu, Irene, and [[Robert T Sturgeon|Robert]] watch as Bucky Wise turns into a humanoid manifestation of the Demon himself. He is defeated for the final time, impaled through the abdomen by a fully charged Dragon Sword as Ryu ran him through.
However it is revealed that Katherine was in possession of the Demon bone, filling her with dark energy. It is unknown what happened to her or it.

== Strategy ==
During the whole fight, the Demon will shoot out a volley of projectiles from his dorso in a random pattern; each projectile decreases the player's physical strength by 3. Since finding the sporadic openings to wound the vital spots of the boss is the key to victory, mashing the attack button must be avoided at all cost to have the time to move around the projectile barrage. The first target to strike is the head of the Demon; jump and attack one or two times. After 11 hits, the head will come off and launch itself forward, inevitably hitting Hayabusa<ref>See notes.</ref> and decreasing his physical strength by a mere single point. Now it's time to strike the tail 16 times, before moving onto the core, which also has 16 hit points.

Note that while dying to the Demon will send the player back to Act 6 - 1 "Death Bridge", they will not have to fight either the [[Joe Hayabusa|Masked Devil]] or [[Jaquio]] again; this means the player can collect and use the Jump & Slash Technique on this final boss. 

== Notes ==
* [[Vigoor]] from the ''[[Ninja Gaiden (Xbox)|Ninja Gaiden (2004)]]'', and [[Vazdah]] from ''[[Ninja Gaiden II]]'' are the modern iteration of this classic boss.

* While the Demon is the first Archfiend fought in the series, chronologically it is the last fought by Ryu Hayabusa so far.

* It has been long thought impossible to avoid the final attack of the Demon's head without the Jump & Slash Technique, but on December 2020 — 32 years after the game released — youtuber [https://www.youtube.com/@slackanater6639 Slackanater] achieved a [https://youtu.be/cJtmZpRTVO8 flawless playthrough] by performing a very precise series of quick slashes to deplete the remining 5 hit points of the head before it could even fall off.
